"""Fresh bounded pure-reader observation; no Godot or generated resource claim."""
import hashlib, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'source/tools'))
import dd1_import_semantics as semantics
selection=json.loads((root/'METADATA-SELECTION.json').read_text())
results=[]
for item in selection['inputs']:
    path=root/item['local']; raw=path.read_bytes()
    assert semantics.blob(raw)==item['git_blob']
    assert raw.decode('utf-8')==item['text']
    doc=semantics.document(raw); targets=semantics.paths(doc)
    assert semantics.string(doc['remap']['importer'])==item['importer']
    assert semantics.string(doc['deps']['source_file'])+'.import'=='res://'+item['path']
    assert raw==path.read_bytes()
    results.append({'path':item['path'],'git_blob':semantics.blob(raw),'bytes':len(raw),
        'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'document':doc,'targets':targets,
        'result':'PASS','unchanged':True})
print(json.dumps({'run_id':selection['run_id'],'I':selection['I'],'status':'NEW_EXECUTION_NOT_RECOVERY',
    'count':len(results),'results':results,'engine_runs':0,'live_account_writes':0,
    'claim':'BOUNDED_TRACKED_METADATA_READER_ONLY; no assets or generated resources executed/validated'},indent=2))
